```{r}
#| label: setup

# Loading Libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Loading Data
data <- readRDS("../data/processed/imvigor210_prepared.rds")
expr <- data$tpm
metadata <- data$clinical

# Output directories
plot_dir <- "../results/plots"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
outdata_dir <- "../data/processed"
dir.create(outdata_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: align-samples

# Check that all patient IDs are present in the expression matrix
stopifnot(all(metadata$pat_id %in% colnames(expr)))

# Reorder expression columns to match the metadata
expr <- expr[, match(metadata$pat_id, colnames(expr)), drop = FALSE]

# Verify that sample order is identical
stopifnot(identical(as.character(metadata$pat_id), colnames(expr)))

# Check the response distribution
table(metadata$BOR, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
#| label: extract-tmb-pd1

# Tumor mutational burden
TMB <- metadata$TMB

# Confirm that PDCD1 is present in the expression matrix
stopifnot("PDCD1" %in% rownames(expr))

# Extract and log-transform PDCD1 expression
PD1 <- log2(as.numeric(expr["PDCD1", ]) + 1)

summary(TMB)
summary(PD1)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-gep

GEP_data <- readRDS("../data/processed/RQ2_GEP_scores.rds")

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(GEP_data$pat_id))
stopifnot(all(metadata$pat_id %in% GEP_data$pat_id))

GEP_scores <- GEP_data$GEP_score[
  match(metadata$pat_id, GEP_data$pat_id)
]

stopifnot(!anyNA(GEP_scores))
```

```{r}
#| label: create-analysis-data-and-test-response-biomarkers

# Combining biomarkers
df <- data.frame(
  sample = metadata$pat_id,
  TMB = TMB,
  PD1 = PD1,
  GEP_scores = GEP_scores,
  BOR = factor(metadata$BOR, levels = c("NR", "R"))
)

stopifnot(identical(df$sample, colnames(expr)))

# Save biomarker data for RQ4
saveRDS(
  df,
  file = file.path(outdata_dir, "RQ3_biomarker_data.rds")
)

# Tests
TMB_test <- wilcox.test(TMB ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)
PD1_test <- wilcox.test(PD1 ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)
GEP_test <- wilcox.test(GEP_scores ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)

TMB_test
PD1_test
GEP_test

# Save Wilcoxon test results
wilcoxon_results <- data.frame(
  Biomarker = c("TMB", "PDCD1", "T-cell GEP"),
  W = c(
    unname(TMB_test$statistic),
    unname(PD1_test$statistic),
    unname(GEP_test$statistic)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    TMB_test$p.value,
    PD1_test$p.value,
    GEP_test$p.value
  )
)

write.csv(
  wilcoxon_results,
  file.path(outdata_dir, "RQ3_wilcoxon_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-response-biomarkers

plot_Response_boxplot <- function(data, variable, y_label, test_result) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = BOR, y = .data[[variable]], fill = BOR)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("p = ", signif(test_result$p.value, 3)),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Treatment response",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: TMB-distribution-plot

TMB_plot <- plot_Response_boxplot(
  df,
  "TMB",
  "Tumor mutational burden (mut/Mb)",
  TMB_test
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "RQ3_TMB_distribution_boxplot.png"),
  plot = TMB_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

TMB_plot
```

GEP_plot

```{r}
#| label: compare-biomarkers

biomarker_summary <- df |>
  group_by(BOR) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_TMB = sum(!is.na(TMB)),
    median_TMB = median(TMB, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_PD1 = median(PD1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_GEP = median(GEP_scores, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  biomarker_summary,
  file.path(outdata_dir, "RQ3_biomarker_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

biomarker_summary
```
